# Errors and I/O

Failures are **exceptions**. Files and other resources are **context managers** (`with`). Paths are **`pathlib.Path`**, not string concatenation.

## Planned chapters

| Chapter | Focus |
|---------|--------|
| `try` / `except` / `raise` | Catch what you can handle; let the rest go |
| Exception groups (3.11+) | Several failures at once |
| `pathlib` | Read, write, walk a tree |
| `with` and your own context managers | `open`, locks, sessions |
| Text vs bytes | Encoding at the edge |

Until these leaves exist: official [Errors](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/errors.html) and [Input and Output](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/inputoutput.html).
